ios.desc:
TOP PUZZLE GAME FEATURES:
①    Smart puzzle game like you've never tried
②    Unique game scoring system
③    A casual game of logic and strategy (and a bit of luck)
④    Match pairs or neighboring numbers
⑤    Crazy game levels which only a few can pass
⑥    Test your IQ by earning top score
⑦    Gradually challenging level goals
⑧    Use hint when you cannot match numbers
⑨    Brain game for seniors to improve mind's health

A Unique Matching Game!
Casual games fans are not about Math. True? Absolutely not! Take advantage of the smart scoring system and become a billionaire in a challenging tile-matching game. Connect blocks with numbers and score enough to qualify for the next round. It takes both STRATEGY and LUCK to succeed in this Brainteaser, so making it to the top is not going to be a piece of cake.

Game Rules; Tips & Tricks!
Match blocks featuring same digits, or the numbers which differ by one. For example, you can match numbers like ②-②-①-⓪ or ⓪-①-②-②. However, the score will be different, namely 2210 and 122 respectively! So, mind your every move as you match numbers on the board. Take notice of the Block Chain number, as it limits the maximum chain length. Blocks is the amount of number tiles you can match. As you progress, the puzzle board enlarges, featuring more digits. Use hint when you cannot match numbers, but keep in mind that the prompted combination might not be the best-scoring one.

A Casual Game with Hardcore Challenge!
There are lots of puzzles with numbers among tile-matching games. However, most of them are simple tapping of Merge games, in which you have to match numbers to arrive at the highest possible number. It’s not the case with Billion Block Chain Puzzle. The Brainteaser takes a usual casual game mechanics and gradually rises the difficulty level to true hardcore. Such puzzles are addicting brain games which develop logic skills. That’s why they may be regarded as games for seniors, helping the elderly to improve your mind’s health, memory and concentration. So, play our brain-training games and aim to become a billionaire.
